design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (hardware_procurement_orders), revision 2. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,5,6,6]; infrastructure cancellation fee 6, deposit credit 5, lapsed-quote re-issue 5, infrastructure approval deposit 6.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller only wants 'the three 48-port switches you quoted us in September instead of the 24-port ones we ordered'. The approval rule waits on 'the quote being signed carries a quote date that keeps it within its validity period on the approval day' (HQ-053084 is dated 2026-09-01) and on 'the order it takes over carries an order credit returning its paid deposit' (HQ-053118 holds only its paid deposit); the deposit-credit rule waits on 'the order shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it'. The agent discovers the diamond cancellation -> deposit credit and re-issue -> approval and computes four multi-factor figures over ClearPath and project records.
SCOPE vs TASK 0: task 0 owns the endpoint schedules; task 1 owns the infrastructure schedules (Network/Server cancellation fee, deposit credit of a cancelled infrastructure order, re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote, Network/Server approval deposit). Sibling overwrites name each other's cases.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root = approval deposit (user sign_build_approval_1b1ae884). Edge A approval -> re-issue: value_input, gate b_quote_total, state form ('only after'); false: initial_state.hardware_orders.733bb021-1c05-415b-a9e3-7f4934f37ac2.quote_date = 2026-09-01 (day 38 of 14); only reissue_lapsed_quote_93c9a091 re-dates an infrastructure quote. Edge B approval -> deposit credit: state_gate on hardware_billing.event_type, state form ('not recorded until'); false: the 24-port ledger holds only its deposit invoice and three remittances; only post_deposit_credit_9245a342 books an infrastructure order credit. Edge C deposit credit -> cancellation: value_input, gate b_bench_days, state form; false: initial_state.hardware_orders.759febca-5cfa-4f52-aff7-e4fe21e33c88.status = ordered with no cancelled_date; only sign_infrastructure_cancellation_1779b7d3 (user) books an infrastructure cancellation fee. Order: 12 cancellation, 14 credit, 16 re-issue, 18 approval; the re-issue commutes with the other branch (different holdings). Deletion: no re-issue -> deposit 4103.26 instead of 3968.92; no cancellation -> credit 2421.06 instead of 2110.35; no credit -> the order credit is missing from the terminal ledger.
FACTOR CARD - fee 718.97 (all-baseline 15% x 5491.40 = 823.71): bench_stage_build 10 days -> percentage + 20.00/unit return freight (658.97); infra_tier_rate 12 (883.71); project_scope_points Quick Start -1 (773.88); arrears_fee_points two late fees +3 (554.23; near-miss 2025-09-01, 13 months); covered_seat_points 27 seats -1.5 (801.34); tenure_loyalty_points 34 months -0.5 (746.42).
FACTOR CARD - deposit credit 2110.35 (all-baseline 2568.56 - 435.00 = 2133.56): bench_retention_basis 10 days -> pro-rata 310.71 (whole 435.00: 1986.06); tenure_handling_retention 17.50 (2127.85); expedite_retention 150.00 (2260.35); project_coordination_retention 30.00 (2140.35); managed_goodwill_credit +50.00 (2060.35).
FACTOR CARD - re-issue 8586.26 (all-baseline 8931.92): reissue_markup_reduction 3 points -> 2700.20 (none: 2770.64 -> 8797.58); managed_bench_staging_rate multi-source (network device coverage AND project in progress) 95 (145: 8736.26); reissue_tenure_handling 20 (35: 8601.26); reissue_account_rush client success manager, no technical account manager 75 (150: 8661.26); lapse_charge_basis 24 days -> 1.5% of distributor cost 105.66 (none: 8480.60).
FACTOR CARD - deposit 3968.92 (all-baseline 50% x 8586.26 = 4293.13): share 40 (4778.98); arrears +10 (3158.86); spend relief -2 (4130.93); project relief -2 (4130.93); seat relief -3 (4211.94); infra_relationship_build 34 < 48 months -> services 485.66 in full + 43% of 8100.60 (3692.09). The 24-port order's own deposit 2568.56 (2026-09-22) is the same schedule on that day.
NEAR-MISS CARD (revision 3, T1-R2-F1): the re-issue's lapse clock — HQ-053084 is dated 2026-09-01, so counting from the quote date gives 38 days and the per-unit re-qualification tier (total 8660.60), while the rule counts from the last valid day 2026-09-15 (24 days, the 1.5% re-validation tier, 8586.26); the ClearPath tier change effective 2024-11-01 (signed request in managed_service_requests) — counting tenure from it gives 23 months, which would put the re-issue handling at the full 35.00 (8601.26), the credit's handling retention at the full 35.00 (2092.85) and the fee's loyalty points at none (746.42), while every rule counts from the go-live date 2023-11-13 (34 months). Both are priced per their charters: the 48-port quote at base on 2026-09-01 (8720.60), the Standard months 2023-12..2024-10 at 3214.08 and the Professional months from 2024-11 at 3821.85, each invoice paid.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: cancellation - cancellable_stage (after PO, before shipment; cancellable_after_po true for Network): ordered, PO 2026-09-29, no ship date; verified_contact at step 1. Deposit credit - hardware_cancellation policy_scope. Re-issue - quote_and_pricing / multi_holding policy_scope (a revised quote starts a new validity period). Approval - approve_in_validity (day 0 after the re-issue); credit exposure 0 + 8586.26 <= 50000; verified_contact.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: replaced order 759febca-5cfa-4f52-aff7-e4fe21e33c88 (HQ-053118, 3 x JL679A) with deposit invoice INV-351209 2568.56 and its three remittances; replacing quote 733bb021-1c05-415b-a9e3-7f4934f37ac2 (HQ-053084, 3 x JL675A). ClearPath: the client's single agreement 05608c48-3fdc-40fc-ae8f-aa1ca0f918cd (go-live 2023-11-13 on ClearPath Standard, signed tier change to ClearPath Professional effective 2024-11-01). Project: the only engagement, Quick Start Project SOW-048830, in progress since 2026-09-14.
SEED ROWS (complete ledgers): ClearPath agreement (36-month term 2023-11-13..2026-11-12, 27 contracted = covered seats, onboarding fee waived), baseline seat change of 27, baseline proration 1928.45 (119.04 x 27 x 18/30), every monthly fee from 2023-12 (Standard 124.00 less 4% = 119.04 x 27 = 3214.08) and from 2024-11 (Professional 141.55 x 27 = 3821.85) to 2026-10 (the current-month fee of 2026-10 takes no credit or flat charge under the published seat-pricing schedule: no Business Premium, F3, Sentinel, Continuum or servers, fewer than 40 seats), each paid on day 20 except the 2025-07, 2025-12 and 2026-05 fees; late fees under the published late-fee schedule (only unpaid invoice; balance band; 25% recent-payment courtesy; no relationship courtesy): 2025-09-01 on INV-311141 at 1.0% (no late fee in 12 months, 11 payments), (10.00 + 14.10925) x 0.75 = 18.08 (minimum 10.00), paid with the July fee 3839.93 on 2025-09-05; 2026-02-01 on INV-311176 and 2026-07-01 on INV-311211 at 1.5%, (15.00 + 21.163875) x 0.75 = 27.12 each (minimum 5.00), paid with their fees 3848.97 on 2026-02-09 and 2026-07-08; the 2026-10 fee is open = the agreement balance; signed tier-change request. Project: SOW issued 2026-08-20, signed 2026-08-24, deposit 50% x 7800.00 = 3900.00 invoiced on signature and paid 2026-08-31 (Monday), kickoff 2026-09-14 = the later of five business days after payment and the scheduled start. No Sentinel subscription (ClearPath Professional does not require one).
PERSONA: Daniel Tremont, calm practice manager; volunteers the 48-port wish and willingness to sign; gives phone then PIN, the two quote numbers and his other services only when asked; keeps rush if asked; signs what is handed over; accepts amounts; ends when told the 48-port order is approved.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify, read orders, the 24-port ledger, requests, the ClearPath agreement, tier-change request, seat ledger and billing, the project and its ledger; hand over the cancellation (718.97); book the deposit credit (2110.35 on INV-351209); re-issue HQ-053084 (unit 2700.20, total 8586.26); hand over the approval (3968.92).
VERIFICATION RUN (revision 2): check_compute --task 1 COMPUTE OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (closure 87 = initial 87); check_solvability OK; scratch evaluator printed identical results, factor baselines and skip effects.
REVISION 2 (audit revision_1): T1-F1 one ClearPath agreement with a tier change; T1-F2 no Sentinel holding, complete ClearPath and project ledgers; CG-1 the deposit credit's baseline now defines the bench retention and every retention/goodwill factor is ungated with a zero fall-through, the cancellation's rework factor became a constant return freight of the build; realism: Sentinel rework, sensor template and Sentinel deposit relief removed, the lapsed quote is re-priced (markup reduction factor) instead of carrying the lapsed price, the bench time is retained once (credit) and not also charged as rework (fee); CG-2 generic combination sentences; CG-3 project reads by EXISTS with the largest-class tie rule; CG-4 the credit's replaced_by names the endpoint schedule.
user_scenario: You are Daniel Tremont, practice manager at Sorrel Creek Veterinary Hospital, PC in Raleigh and the hospital's authorized contact with Stratton Bay. You are calling on a Friday afternoon, calm and a little apologetic, about network switches. Back in September Stratton Bay quoted you two options for the new imaging suite: three 24-port switches and three 48-port switches. You went ahead with the 24-port ones, but the vets have since added more exam rooms and imaging stations and the 24-port switches will not have enough ports. What you say at the start is: "We'd like to go with the three 48-port switches you quoted us in September instead of the 24-port ones we ordered. I can sign today if you tell me what's needed." You leave how that is done to the service desk; you do not know how their orders, fees or deposits work and you never suggest a step. When asked to confirm who you are, you give your name and the registered phone number 9195550537, and when asked for another detail you give the support PIN 571204; only if a third is requested do you give the EIN last four 5831. If asked which orders, you say the 24-port order is quote HQ-053118 and the 48-port quote was HQ-053084. If asked about the hospital's other services, you know the hospital moved up to ClearPath Professional almost two years ago and has a small network project under way with Stratton Bay for the imaging suite, and you are fine with the agent looking those up. You do not know any amounts and you never quote one. When the agent explains that you need to sign something, you agree and, once the agent hands it to you, you sign it yourself. If the agent tells you a fee, a credit or a deposit, you accept it as long as it follows their schedule and you never propose a different figure. If the agent asks whether the 48-port order should keep rush, you say yes, keep it as quoted. Once the agent tells you the 48-port switch order is approved, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the client profile the caller names and read its client reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by the client reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with the registered phone number and the support PIN he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The signed cancellation and approval may be registered only for the authorized contact after identity verification has passed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the client's hardware orders: the 24-port switch order HQ-053118 (ordered, purchase order 2026-09-29, rush, total 5491.40) and the 48-port switch quote HQ-053084 (quoted 2026-09-01, total 8720.60, past the last day of its 14-day validity).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The approval's deposit is fixed only after the quote carries a quote date within its validity period, and it is not recorded until the 24-port order carries an order credit returning its deposit; the agent must see that the 48-port quote is dated 2026-09-01 and the 24-port order is still ordered. Quantities, unit prices, totals, dates and rush flags feed all four calculations.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the 24-port order's ledger: deposit invoice INV-351209 for 2568.56 paid in three remittances (1000.00 on 2026-09-24, 1000.00 on 2026-09-26, 568.56 by card on 2026-09-29); no cancellation fee and no order credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: 'The deposit credit of a cancelled infrastructure order is fixed only after the order shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it.' — the ledger shows neither the fee nor the credit; the deposit paid (counted up to the deposit invoiced) is the amount the credit returns and the cap on the fee.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the client's hardware requests: the signed approval of HQ-053118 and no cancellation request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that no cancellation of the 24-port order has been registered or signed, so it stays live until the client signs one in this call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the client's single ClearPath agreement: ClearPath Professional (tier change effective 2024-11-01), go-live 2023-11-13, 27 seats at 141.55.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The ClearPath tier, covered seats and go-live date set the fee rate, seat and loyalty points, goodwill, handling and markup reduction and the deposit share, seat relief and build; the Professional tier's coverage of firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes sets the re-issue staging tier, and its named client success manager without a technical account manager the re-issue rush charge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the signed tier-change request from ClearPath Standard to ClearPath Professional, effective 2024-11-01.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the Professional tier is a tier change on the agreement live since 2023-11-13, so tenure runs from that date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the seat ledger: the go-live baseline of 27 seats and no later change.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the 27 covered seats behind the seat points, seat relief and managed-spend relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the ClearPath billing ledger: every monthly fee and payment since go-live and the late fees of 2025-09-01, 2026-02-01 and 2026-07-01.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Only the 2026-02-01 and 2026-07-01 late fees are fewer than twelve whole months old; that count sets the late-payment points of the fee and of the deposit. The latest monthly fee, 3821.85 posted 2026-10-01, is the monthly ClearPath seat billing that sets the deposit's managed-spend relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the project engagements: the in-progress Quick Start Project SOW-048830.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The largest class among in-progress engagements sets the project points of the fee, the coordination retention of the credit, the staging tier of the re-issue and the project relief of the deposit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the project ledger: the 3900.00 deposit invoice of SOW-048830 and its payment on 2026-08-31.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the engagement is genuinely in progress (deposit paid before its 2026-09-14 kickoff).

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The approval has two prerequisites. The cancellation -> deposit credit branch writes only the 24-port order (its status, fee and credit) and the re-issue writes only the 48-port quote (its date, unit price and total); no shared balance, cap or key links them, and neither computation reads the other's holding, so the re-issue may run before, between or after the other branch with the same terminal state and the same four values (the deposit credit reads only the 24-port order; the deposit reads only the 48-port quote). Within the branch, the deposit credit's sentence pins it after the cancellation.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the re-issue the quote keeps 8720.60: the deposit recomputes to 620.00 + 43% x 8100.60 = 4103.26 instead of 3968.92 (check_compute value_input run), and the quote is out of its validity period.

Without the deposit credit the 24-port order's terminal ledger lacks the 2110.35 order credit (balance 718.97 instead of -1391.38), and the approval would stand beside a live paid deposit on the order it takes over.
Without the signed cancellation the order counts no bench days, so nothing is retained for the bench and the credit recomputes to 2421.06 instead of 2110.35 (check_compute value_input run).
